import torch
import flashinfer


def run(hidden_states, residual, weight):
    batch_size, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
    
    assert hidden_size == 2048
    
    EPS = 1e-6
    
    # FlashInfer's fused_add_rmsnorm modifies hidden_states in-place
    flashinfer.norm.fused_add_rmsnorm(hidden_states, residual, weight, EPS)
    
    # Return the modified hidden_states as output
    return hidden_states

description: Solution using FlashInfer's optimized fused_add_rmsnorm kernel for efficient GPU-based fused addition and RMS normalization with hidden_size=2048.
